content:
carla: Starting a small docs sweep for Aurorax model card. Need limits corrected, benchmark rows added, and SDK snippets updated. I'll open the PR and assign tasks.

alice: Sounds good. Which exact limit is wrong?

carla: The card shows 16k tokens but our tests indicate 12k is the practical cap; after ~8k perf drops. Change to 12k recommended and add a short note about degradation past 8k.

ben: I can do the Python and JS snippets. Prefer short, canonical snippets. Replace old `client.text.generate` with `client.generate` and add a one-line migration blurb.

david: I ran quick perf on p4d: tokens/sec = 2300 (@512), 1900 (@1024), 1200 (@4096), 400 (@12288). Command: `python bench.py --model aurorax-7b --instance p4d --batch 1 --seq 512 1024 4096 12288`. Config: fp16, kv-cache on.

carla: Perfect. I'll add those numbers to the benchmark table and include an "expected degradation" row. Also add compatibility note: CUDA >=12.2, driver >=535.

alice: I'll run link lint and replace the stale quant guide link `/quant-old` -> `/optimize/quant`.

ben: For streaming snippet I'll show `for chunk in resp.stream():` and add a comment to check `model.capabilities.streaming`.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/3420 branch `docs/aurorax-sweep-1961002222`. Checklist created: limits, benchmarks, snippets, links, compat badge.

carla: Assigning snippets and link fixes to @ben. @alice will proofread and run lint. @david please attach bench CSV to the PR comment. Aim to merge by EOD tomorrow.

david: Attached CSV to PR.

ben: Starting on snippets now. Will ping if I hit blockers. :hammer_and_wrench:

carla: Thanks team. Keep follow-ups in this thread.
